name: pdf-preview-next
description: Fast, secure PDF viewing in VS Code by machine-made: true dark mode, the latest PDF.js (6.4.299) in a real worker thread, live reload for LaTeX/Typst including WSL, search, outline, reliable preview state, and one right-click to open PDFs and Markdown in the pdf-next app.

commands.title: vscode-pdf Next: Open in System Viewer for Printing
vscode-pdf Next: Print Directly to Default Printer
vscode-pdf Next: Clear Page Mode (Plain White Pages)

pdf-preview.default.cursor.markdownDescription: The default cursor tool for preview.

pdf-preview.default.scale.markdownDescription: The default zoom level for preview. Allowed values are `auto`, `page-actual`, `page-fit`, `page-width`, and 1-based scale values. (`1.0` means 100%)

pdf-preview.default.sidebar.markdownDescription: Open the PDF sidebar by default when the active sidebar panel is available.

pdf-preview.default.sidebarPanel.markdownDescription: The sidebar panel to show when the PDF sidebar opens. `pdf-preview.default.sidebar` still controls whether the sidebar opens by default.

pdf-preview.default.scrollMode.markdownDescription: The default scroll mode for preview.

pdf-preview.default.spreadMode.markdownDescription: The default spread mode for preview.

pdf-preview.reload.closeOnDelete.markdownDescription: Close the preview when the opened PDF is deleted. Disable this for TeX-style build workflows that temporarily delete and recreate the PDF.

pdf-preview.reload.automatic.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh the preview when the PDF file changes. Manual reload always works through the toolbar button, the `pdf-preview.refreshPreview` command, and Cmd/Ctrl+R.

pdf-preview.reload.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after PDF file change notifications before refreshing the preview. Increase this if your build tool writes PDFs in multiple bursts.

pdf-preview.appearance.theme.markdownDescription: Preview appearance. `auto` follows VS Code colors for viewer chrome and leaves pages plain white, `dark` uses dark viewer chrome while leaving PDF pages unchanged, `night` asks PDF.js to recolor rendered PDF pages for lower-eye-strain reading, `sepia` (formerly `reader`, which still works) renders pages with a warm e-reader palette, `dark-pages` is a compatibility alias for `night`, and `inverted` applies full-page CSS inversion as a fallback for scanned or image-heavy PDFs. The toolbar button cycles Clear, Night, Invert and Sepia, so plain white pages are always one press away; Shift+click or right-click it, or run **vscode-pdf Next: Clear Page Mode**, to jump straight back to Clear.

pdf-preview.copy.autoCopySelection.markdownDescription: Automatically copy selected PDF text to the clipboard when the mouse button is released. Disabled by default because it writes to the clipboard without an explicit copy command.

pdf-preview.printCommand.markdownDescription: Custom command line used only by `vscode-pdf Next: Print Directly to Default Printer`. Use `{{file}}` as a placeholder for the PDF path; when omitted, the path is appended as the last argument. The command is executed without a shell. When empty, direct printing tries the default CUPS printer, then falls back to the system viewer.

pdf-preview.pdfNext.path.markdownDescription: Path to the [pdf-next](https://github.com/machine-made/pdf-next) app used by **Open in pdf-next**. Leave empty to find it on `PATH` and in the usual install folders. On macOS you can give the `.app` bundle.

pdf-preview.pdfNext.saveBeforeOpen.markdownDescription: Save an edited file before **Open in pdf-next** opens it, because pdf-next reads the file on disk.

pdf-preview.pdfNext.showInTitleBar.markdownDescription: Show the **Open in pdf-next** button in the title bar of the PDF preview.

pdf-preview.pdfNext.showInMarkdownTitleB.markdownDescription: Show the **Open in pdf-next** button in the title bar of Markdown editors. The command is always on the right-click menus.

scripts.pretest: bun run bundle && bun run test:compat
